name: La
source:
Main female character of the story. Mysterious girl who became [url=/c333]Kurome[/url]'s Guest. Always considerate, always making sure she is not in the way, and trying to make other people happy, she has an exceptionally pure heart and and an exceptionally strong will.

[spoiler]She is Omega rank Mnemonicide.[/spoiler]
